definitions: In India, IGP stands for Inspector General of Police. It is a high-ranking officer in the Indian Police Service.
In the context of networking, IGP stands for Interior Gateway Protocol. It is a type of protocol used for exchanging routing information between gateways within an autonomous system.
examples: The IGP visited the crime scene.
The network uses OSPF as its IGP.
An IGP is responsible for maintaining law and order in their zone.
RIP is another example of an IGP.
